records.title: Customer signs in
records.description: Sample scenario: a verified customer account. the account overview is displayed.
records.gherkin_document:
Feature: Customer signs in

  Background: Preconditions
    Given a verified customer account

  Scenario: Customer signs in
    When the customer signs in with <email>
    Then the account overview is displayed

records.title: Customer completes checkout
records.description: Sample scenario: a basket with an in-stock product. one order is created and a receipt is displayed.
records.gherkin_document:
Feature: Customer completes checkout

  Background: Preconditions
    Given a basket with an in-stock product

  Scenario: Customer completes checkout
    When the customer pays with <payment_method>
    Then one order is created and a receipt is displayed

records.title: Checkout supports keyboard navigation
records.description: Sample scenario: checkout is open without using a pointer. focus remains visible and reaches the confirmation button.
records.gherkin_document:
Feature: Checkout supports keyboard navigation

  Background: Preconditions
    Given checkout is open without using a pointer

  Scenario: Checkout supports keyboard navigation
    When the customer tabs through each payment control
    Then focus remains visible and reaches the confirmation button

records.title: Expired sessions preserve the basket
records.description: Sample scenario: a basket exists and the session has expired. the basket is restored without exposing another account.
records.gherkin_document:
Feature: Expired sessions preserve the basket

  Background: Preconditions
    Given a basket exists and the session has expired

  Scenario: Expired sessions preserve the basket
    When the customer signs in again
    Then the basket is restored without exposing another account

records.title: Declined payments allow a safe retry
records.description: Sample scenario: the payment provider declines the first authorization. one charge and one order are created.
records.gherkin_document:
Feature: Declined payments allow a safe retry

  Background: Preconditions
    Given the payment provider declines the first authorization

  Scenario: Declined payments allow a safe retry
    When the customer retries with an approved payment method
    Then one charge and one order are created

records.title: Inventory API returns available stock
records.description: Sample scenario: SKU <sku> exists in the staging inventory. the response is 200 and available quantity is non-negative.
records.gherkin_document:
Feature: Inventory API returns available stock

  Background: Preconditions
    Given SKU <sku> exists in the staging inventory

  Scenario: Inventory API returns available stock
    When GET /v1/inventory/<sku> is requested
    Then the response is 200 and available quantity is non-negative

records.title: Order API rejects duplicate idempotency keys
records.description: Sample scenario: an order was created with idempotency key <request_key>. the existing order is returned without a second charge.
records.gherkin_document:
Feature: Order API rejects duplicate idempotency keys

  Background: Preconditions
    Given an order was created with idempotency key <request_key>

  Scenario: Order API rejects duplicate idempotency keys
    When POST /v1/orders is repeated with the same key
    Then the existing order is returned without a second charge

records.title: Order API requires authentication
records.description: Sample scenario: no customer authorization is provided. the response is 401 without customer information.
records.gherkin_document:
Feature: Order API requires authentication

  Background: Preconditions
    Given no customer authorization is provided

  Scenario: Order API requires authentication
    When GET /v1/orders is requested
    Then the response is 401 without customer information

records.title: Mobile basket survives an app restart
records.description: Sample scenario: a customer added a product to the mobile basket. the product and quantity are retained.
records.gherkin_document:
Feature: Mobile basket survives an app restart

  Background: Preconditions
    Given a customer added a product to the mobile basket

  Scenario: Mobile basket survives an app restart
    When the app is closed and reopened
    Then the product and quantity are retained

records.title: Mobile checkout explains an offline connection
records.description: Sample scenario: the basket has an in-stock product. an offline message is shown and the basket remains intact.
records.gherkin_document:
Feature: Mobile checkout explains an offline connection

  Background: Preconditions
    Given the basket has an in-stock product

  Scenario: Mobile checkout explains an offline connection
    When the customer starts checkout without a network connection
    Then an offline message is shown and the basket remains intact

records.title: Mobile controls have accessible labels
records.description: Sample scenario: the accessibility reader is enabled. each control announces its name and state.
records.gherkin_document:
Feature: Mobile controls have accessible labels

  Background: Preconditions
    Given the accessibility reader is enabled

  Scenario: Mobile controls have accessible labels
    When the customer navigates basket controls
    Then each control announces its name and state
